In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Hsp90 plays an important role in the maturation of tRNA, which in turn is essential for bacterial growth at high temperature.
Hsp90 prevents the aggregation of TilS at high temperature, thereby allowing the cell to survive heat stress.
bacterial Hsp90 is an essential protein under heat stress, and TilS is a bacterial Hsp90 client.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
bacterial Hsp90 is an essential chaperone for a client protein, TilS, which is essential under heat stress.
Hsp90 prevents the aggregation of TilS at high temperature, thereby ensuring the essential function of TilS for cell survival.
Hsp90 plays an essential role in S. Oneidensis under high temperature by preventing aggregation and stabilizing TilS, an essential protein involved in tRNAs maturation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
bacterial Hsp90 is required under stress conditions, and its essentiality is due to its function as a chaperone for essential proteins.
bacterial Hsp90 is not just a passive chaperone, but rather an essential protein that is required to maintain the activity and the amount of at least one essential client protein under heat stress.
Hsp90 has a crucial function in bacteria under heat stress, which is likely to be related to the activity and/or stability of a subset of client proteins.
